main.description: A feed post authored by a member: the public social unit. Present in the author's repo only when the post's visibility is public; private posts stay in the org store and are never records.

text.description: The post body, in plain text.

group.description: Optional: the public group or event this was posted in (a wiki.radikal.group / wiki.radikal.event record).

reply.description: Optional: the post this is a reply to (thread parent).
